title: 하지만
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL Korean Basic Dictionary defines **하지만** as an adverb used to connect two sentences whose contents oppose one another. This entry is limited to that explicit contrastive function; it does not claim that 하지만 has every discourse use of 그런데 or that one Spanish translation fits every context.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). 하지만. In *Korean Basic Dictionary*. National Institute of Korean Language. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicMarinerSearch/search?mainSearchWord=-%EC%A7%80%EB%A7%8C

Korean Basic Dictionary, search entry 하지만, definition: “a word used to connect two statements that are opposite in meaning to each other.”

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-지만**, que expresa contraste dentro de una construcción, y con **그런데**. Se distingue de **그래서**, que normalmente introduce una consecuencia en lugar de una oposición.
